title: Please check it out? ❤️
author: Willsonn85
selftext:
A simple addictive brick break style game with twists.

https://makeplay.ai/p/at5krtepm6

comments.author: MessageSelfdestructs
comments.body: Played it for one minute, then got frustrated with the paddle, as even if the ball hits the left side of the paddle, the ball will still go to the right: that's not how Arkanoid worked...

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body:
Same here. The game doesn't do the one basic thing it should be doing. Vibe coding without supervision.

It's also way too slow to be addictive.

replies.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
replies.body: Be respectul to others and follow reddits guidelines and policies.

comments.author: Psychological-Ad5569
comments.body: The reward message popped up over the paddle and I couldn’t see it in my game.  I tried to hit the blinking lights on the side but nothing happened.

replies.author: Willsonn85
replies.body: On each 5th level you get power ups I know it's not great and sometimes I tell it to do things that it won't accept. Thanks for checking it out anyway.

comments.author: jruu_uu
comments.body: Gameplay is incredibly slow, player spends too much time waiting for the ball. Did you playtest this yourself before publishing?

comments.author: Kalaminator
comments.body: Extremely boring, slow, no power ups, only played the first level, the second level looks exactly the same. If there is anything interesting, you didn't caught my attention to wait for it. What are even the coins for? I am thirsty for a good Arkanoid style game, so you had my attention, this is rubbish. This is not additive, this IS simple though. Stop thinking 4 prompts games can be any good and put some effort into it...

replies.author: Kalaminator
replies.body: If you actually wanted there could be so much to do with it, instead of all boring green creatures, make them different, make them different colors too, make it so that some of them can move with a certain trigger (removing those around it or the like) You could even have "interactive power ups" Instead of just a power up, keeping the theme that the "blocks" look like creatures for example one of them spits a ball that basically gives you 2 balls to play with, etc. Make the bar move a bit faster and you could combine Galaga style with Arkanoid. These are just random ides from the top of my head, you do it the way you like it, but what you have now is not impressive at all. AI is a tool, but you have to actually think.

replies.author: Willsonn85
replies.body: Played the first level...that's your answer 🤦🏼‍♂️

replies.author: Kalaminator
replies.body: No, don't be delusional, if you ask for opinion take it, the game needs your attention, not other's.
